title: PowerDisplay needs to rescan monitors after coming back to physical session from a remote desktop session
author: DeshmukhMalhar

judgment.rationale: The issue gives a clear RDP transition and says manual Rescan Connected restores monitor detection, while the only stated build is 0.100.2. A plausible stale-monitor-list hypothesis is testable, but the reporter's screenshot reply did not confirm whether the issue persists on a current stable build.
evidence: The reporter describes starting Power Display locally, connecting and disconnecting Remote Desktop, then returning to find no monitors until Rescan Connected is used.
A screenshot was added in the discussion; no later comment confirms a current-build retest.
The report's stated PowerToys version is 0.100.2, and the automated triage comment asked the reporter to update and confirm recurrence.
judgment.recommended_action: Confirm the behavior on the current stable release before advancing the monitor-refresh hypothesis.

fix_assessment.rationale: The recovery through Rescan Connected suggests an automatic topology refresh may be missed, but no current-build reproduction or code trace yet confirms that Power Display owns the failure.

proposed_fixes.title: Refresh Power Display monitor state after returning from RDP
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Power Display may retain a stale monitor enumeration after the display topology changes during an RDP session; the successful manual rescan is consistent with a missed automatic refresh but does not prove the notification path.
plan: Confirm that the issue still reproduces on the current stable build using the reported local-to-RDP-to-local sequence.
Trace Power Display's monitor enumeration and topology-change notification path; compare automatic state after RDP disconnect with the state after Rescan Connected.
If the notification path misses the transition, invalidate and refresh the monitor list on the relevant display/session change and add focused regression coverage.
verification: Run the reported sequence on a current stable build and confirm physical monitors remain visible after returning from RDP without manual rescan.
Verify manual Rescan Connected still recovers the list and that normal local monitor hot-plug changes continue to refresh correctly.

confidence.rationale: Manual rescan recovering the list points toward stale enumeration, but the report is from 0.100.2 and no current-build retest or source-level event trace is available.

issue_context.summary: Power Display loses its detected-monitor list after returning from an RDP session, although the reporter says Rescan Connected restores it.
known_information: The reported PowerToys version is 0.100.2 and the installation method is auto-update.
The body provides the RDP connection/disconnection sequence and states that monitors are missing until Rescan Connected is clicked.
The reporter added a screenshot after an automated triage comment asked for a current stable update; the thread contains no explicit result of that update test.
inferences: The manual recovery is consistent with stale monitor enumeration or a missed topology-change notification.
The evidence does not establish whether the behavior remains in current PowerToys or which monitor notification path is responsible.
issue_context.analysis: The existing repro is specific enough to guide a code investigation, but the issue is old and the requested update check has not been answered. Ask only for the current build and whether the same sequence still fails; do not request generic diagnostics or redesign against a potentially fixed version.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full report and both comments; the second comment is a screenshot and does not answer the requested current-version retest.

Confirmed Power Display owns the reported monitor enumeration/rescan surface under src/modules/powerdisplay/PowerDisplay; no code evidence yet shows whether RDP's topology transition reaches its refresh path.
The existing triage comment already requested an update, so this action asks for the missing version/result rather than repeating a bug-report request.

actions.label: Confirm Power Display behavior on current stable

comment.body:
Thanks for the exact RDP sequence and the screenshot. The report says Rescan Connected restores the monitor list, but the stated PowerToys version is 0.100.2; the screenshot reply did not confirm whether this still happens on a newer build.

Please help distinguish an active monitor-refresh issue from behavior that may already be fixed:

1. Update to the current stable PowerToys release and report the version shown in About.
2. Repeat the same RDP connect, disconnect, and return-to-local sequence. Please confirm whether monitors are detected automatically or remain missing until you click Rescan Connected.

This result determines whether maintainers should trace Power Display's topology-refresh path on a current build.

status.label: Confirm current-build repro
status.detail: The monitor list recovers after a manual rescan, but the issue's only reported build is 0.100.2.

next_action.label: Confirm Power Display behavior on current stable
